title: At the End of the Six-Year Term There Will Be 350,000 New Places for Undergraduate Studies, Sheinbaum Says
author: Emir Olivares and Alonso Urrutia
content:
_This article by[Emir
Olivares](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Emir%20Olivares) and [Alonso
Urrutia](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia) originally
appeared in the [October 12, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/12/politica/al-termino-
del-sexenio-habra-350-mil-nuevos-lugares-para-estudios-de-licenciatura-
asegura-sheinbaum), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo stated that during her six-
year term undergraduate enrollment will be expanded by **350,000 places** , a
figure equivalent "to three National Autonomous Universities of Mexico."

Reiterating that education "is the best tool against violence," the head of
the Executive highlighted that her administration will build new high schools
and universities in order to guarantee that all young people of age to pursue
those studies can do so in public, quality institutions.

"Next year we are going to build more high schools and universities," she said
at this Monday's mañanera. She said this will be done with new high school and
technological campuses, as well as the expansion of existing high schools and
**converting middle schools that have no afternoon shift into high schools**.

To this, she noted, will be added the Margarita Maza high school, "which is a
new educational model," and the strengthening of the telebachilleratos
(distance high schools), "to be part of the national community high school
system, because they have a very community-based vision."

In the case of university campuses, the president specified that more places
are being opened at the Technological University of Mexico, the National
Polytechnic Institute and other public universities in the country.

Likewise, she noted, the push will continue for the Benito Juárez Universities
for Well-Being, created during the term of her predecessor, Andrés Manuel
López Obrador, and the Rosario Castellanos National University, a concept
launched by the president.

> The goal is to have more than 350,000 additional places by the end of the
> six-year term; that would be like three National Autonomous Universities of
> Mexico in undergraduate students.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

However, it is worth noting that according to UNAM statistics, the number of
undergraduate students at that institution for this school year is **231,327
enrolled students**.

On another note, the president highlighted the housing program her government
has undertaken, which she said will benefit 12 million families with loans,
modifications of these, deed registration, among others.

"It is a historic housing access policy. Go around the world and see where
there is another program like this one."
